title: McCord's letter to Judge Sirica

tellings.quote: mcord M mcord out of our office is the one that gets pissed off over the fact that he thinks they're all getting sold down the stream here

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan says that in 1973 James McCord, one of the men caught in the Watergate break-in, grew angry that he and the others were being sold down the river and wrote a letter to John Sirica, the judge hearing the case. Sheehan, who says he was close to it through his office, tells it as the moment that cracked the cover-up open.
